query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compliance_rules (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  dataset_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  cas_number VARCHAR(50),
  material_name VARCHAR(255),
  rule_type ENUM('banned', 'restricted', 'notification_required', 'approved') NOT NULL,
  max_concentration_pct DECIMAL(5, 2) COMMENT 'Maximum allowed concentration (%)',
  rationale TEXT COMMENT 'Why this rule exists (provenance)',
  reference_document VARCHAR(500) COMMENT 'Official document reference',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (dataset_id) REFERENCES compliance_datasets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  INDEX idx_cas_number (cas_number),
  INDEX idx_material_name (material_name)
);
